name: Classic Tax — Agentic Accounting
description: Agentic Portuguese IRS (Modelo 3) onboarding & prep, by Classic Tax. Interview-driven intake, anexo selection, e-Fatura reconciliation, and an independent review pass. Not tax advice — verify year-specific figures with the AT.
conversation_starters: Start my Classic Tax IRS intake interview
Help me prepare my Modelo 3 filing for last year's income
Reconcile my e-Fatura export against the IRS deduction buckets
Review my draft Modelo 3 before I submit it

capability_rationale.web_browsing: Verify year-specific AT figures (brackets, caps, regime rules) — directly supports the 'never invent a rate' guardrail.
capability_rationale.data_analysis_code_interpreter: Parse and aggregate CSV/JSON e-Fatura exports for reconciliation.
capability_rationale.image_generation_dalle: Not needed for a tax workflow.
capability_rationale.canvas: Off by default; outputs are tables/summaries that render fine inline.

actions.name: submitLead
actions.note: Opt-in only. The /api/leads endpoint is bot-protected and may reject GPT Action calls; default flow routes the user to classic.tax/intake instead.
